answer: Effort is cheap; identity is not. horizon: the words rotate inside the epoch, so an answer copied from the last horizon is stale before it lands. nebula: a Sybil cloud looks like a bright fog of many addresses, but seats and rewards follow established history, so the mass earns nothing while each fresh wallet burns gas and vesting time it never recovers. signal: one signed tx per epoch per address is the unit of trust - spoofing it means paying a full re-establishment every single time, which is the cost that makes a fake unaffordable.
